headline: Tech Infrastructure Financing Costs Trigger Market Sell-Off in AI Stocks
summary: A sell-off in AI equities underscored growing investor scrutiny over whether companies constructing artificial intelligence infrastructure can generate sufficient profits to cover financing costs.
why: Capital expenditure demands for high-performance computing hardware directly impact enterprise free cash flows across the tech sector.
why_moved: Concerns over high infrastructure funding costs and profitability timelines sparked selling across AI and technology equities.
